dict.string: Transcription Studio captures system audio to transcribe meetings and calls — entirely on this device. Nothing leaves your Mac.
Transcription Studio adds meetings you review from a transcript to your calendar. It only ever adds — it never reads your existing calendar.
Transcription Studio matches names in your transcripts to your contacts so speakers and mentions show real names — read only, entirely on this device.
Transcription Studio uses Face ID to unlock sessions you've marked private, so only you can open them.
Transcription Studio records from your microphone to transcribe and identify speakers — entirely on this device. Nothing leaves your Mac.
Transcription Studio adds action items you review from a transcript to your reminders.
